about: Official replay videos of the event on YouTube, with chapters where Perplexity could give them, AS REPORTED BY PERPLEXITY: untrusted, not read from YouTube (no YouTube key yet). prompt: List the official recorded talk videos (replays) of Web Summit 2026 (Lisbon, 10 to 13 November 2026) published on the official Web Summit YouTube channel. Answer ONLY with a JSON array, no prose. Each item: {"title": string, "url": "the YouTube video URL", "published": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null, "stage": string or null, "chapters": [{"start": "H:MM:SS", "title": string, "speakers": [names exactly as listed in the video's own description or chapters]}] (empty if you cannot see the chapters)}. Only videos you can cite. At most 30 items.

corrections.what: The event dates in "name" and in the prompt were data.b@'s own error (10 to 13 November); Web Summit 2026 ran 9 to 12 November, with Day Two (Wednesday 11) cancelled. The prompt is kept as it was sent; the topic is corrected for later runs.

Perplexity's video titles differ from YouTube's own (read by the library through oEmbed): "Web Summit 2026 | Day One" and "Web Summit 2026 | Opening Night", not "Web Summit Lisbon 2026 | ...". Do not copy Perplexity's titles, dates, stages or chapter speakers as facts.
